Container.Name: nod-server
Container.Overview:
Nod (6 of 6): Nod is a self-hosted personal AI assistant from the n8n team. This container is the app and API server. Unofficial community packaging, not affiliated with n8n GmbH.
Install this last: nod-postgres, nod-runtime, nod-browser-unraid, nod-workspace-network and nod-workspace-unraid must already be running.
HTTPS is required. Nod only accepts the exact origin set in Public URL, and plain HTTP is allowed only on localhost. Put Nod behind a reverse proxy (for example SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager or Traefik) pointing at this container's port 4310, or use Tailscale Serve, and enter that HTTPS address as Public URL. Opening http://[server IP]:4310 directly returns 403.
On first start Nod generates NOD_AUTH_TOKEN and NOD_VAULT_KEY in [AppData]/secrets.env. Sign in with NOD_AUTH_TOKEN from that file. Back up NOD_VAULT_KEY: without it, saved credentials cannot be decrypted. Connect an AI model after signing in, under Models.
Container.Requires: The "nod" Docker network (docker network create nod), an HTTPS reverse proxy or Tailscale Serve, and the other five nod-* templates installed first.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host port your HTTPS reverse proxy (or Tailscale Serve) forwards to. Direct browser access to this port is refused, because Nod requires HTTPS.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Sessions, settings, encrypted credentials and the generated secrets.env. Ownership is set to uid 1000 on first start.

Config.Name: Workspaces
Config.Description: Session workspaces. Must be the same host folder as Workspaces in nod-workspace-unraid.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The exact HTTPS origin you open Nod at, for example https://nod.example.com (no path or trailing slash).

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Same value as Database password in nod-postgres.

Config.Name: Auth token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to use the token generated in [AppData]/secrets.env. If set: at least 43 letters, digits, - or _.

Config.Name: Vault key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to use the key generated in [AppData]/secrets.env. If set: 32 random bytes, base64 encoded (openssl rand -base64 32). Never change it once credentials are saved.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Container name of the Nod database.

Config.Name: Analytics
Config.Description: Send usage analytics to the Nod team.

Config.Name: Feedback
Config.Description: Enable in-app feedback sent to the Nod team.
